errors.evidence: The chart clearly shows seven slices, not six.

The description incorrectly maps several categories to their percentage values. The correct values are: “Mix-Sound-Music-Speech” (2.4%), “Mix-Music-Speech” (8.2%), “Sound” (16.5%), and “Music” (20.6%). The value for “Music” (1.1%) actually belongs to the “Mix-Sound-Music” category, which is omitted from the description's list.

errors.text_span: The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in size.
errors.evidence: The slices are not ordered from largest to smallest. For example, the largest slice, "Speech" (29.4%), is adjacent to one of the smallest slices, "Mix-Sound-Music" (1.1%).
